hotel.name: InterContinental Costa Rica at Multiplaza Mall

verified_facts.text: Multiplaza Mall is right next door to the hotel, in the Escazú district.
verified_facts.excerpt: The paragon of design and entertainment is right next door. San Jose's Multiplaza Mall caters to the well-heeled in the exclusive Escazú district.

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits in Escazú, where San José's commercial district is.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the vibrant heart of Escazú, where the pulse of San José’s commercial district meets the calm of signature experiences

verified_facts.text: Guests can explore nearby coffee estates and the galleries and boutiques of Avenida Escazú.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore the charm of nearby coffee estates, visit the galleries and boutiques of Avenida Escazú, or take in mountain views from our urban oasis.

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms have views of the mountains, gardens or city.
verified_facts.excerpt: Thoughtfully designed guest rooms with views of the mountains, gardens, or city create a sense of place and perspective.

verified_facts.text: The heated outdoor pools are set amid the greenery and swaying palms of the hotel's gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our three heated outdoor pools provide a refreshing respite from busy days. Swim or lounge under the warm Costa Rican sun amid the lavish greenery and swaying palms of our gardens

verified_facts.text: The pools have poolside beverage and light-menu service.
verified_facts.excerpt: satisfy your cravings with poolside beverage and light-menu service

verified_facts.text: The spa offers individual or couples treatments, and private pools for a soak.
verified_facts.excerpt: Individual or couples treatments relax, rejuvenate, and cleanse. Private pools provide a soothing soak.

verified_facts.text: The spa's outdoor bamboo palapas offer an intimate, candlelit escape.
verified_facts.excerpt: And our outdoor bamboo palapas offer an intimate, candlelit escape.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers restoration shaped by local traditions and global expertise.
verified_facts.excerpt: offers restoration shaped by local traditions and global expertise

verified_facts.text: The Club Tower is a secluded level with a private entrance, with access reserved for the hotel's most loyal guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy access to our exclusive Club Tower, our secluded level with a private entrance reserved for our most loyal guests.

verified_facts.text: Zambra is the lobby bar, serving artisan cocktails, sangrias and tapas-style dishes with live music.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tapas-style dishes satisfy your appetite while live music enhances the intimate ambience.

verified_facts.text: The Market is a casual take on Costa Rica's sodas, or food stalls, where guests build their own meal and can eat on a terrace beside the pool and gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor your creation on our terrace alongside the pool and gardens.

verified_facts.text: The off-site Valle del Sol golf course in Santa Ana is an 18-hole championship course certified as a wildlife sanctuary by Audubon International.
verified_facts.excerpt: there is located the valle del Golf Course, with a spectacular 18 holes championship golf course. Certified as a wildlife sanctuary by Audubon International.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is approximately 15 kilometers from Juan Santamaria Airport (SJO).
verified_facts.excerpt: InterContinental Costa Rica at Multiplaza Mall is conveniently located near Juan Santamaria Airport (SJO), approximately 9.32 miles away (15 kilometers) from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The pool area includes a children's pool and a whirlpool.
